purpose: Test whether a deterministic, zero-provider-call audit can identify the two observed answer-verification regressions without triggering repair on the three paired Judge improvements.
problem: The query-aware harness reduced zero-evidence errors, but two paired regressions either admitted that critical clues were unconfirmed or cited evidence that did not support the requested year.
simpler_baseline: Conservatively trigger repair only when answer-critical citation support is absent and the saved answer explicitly admits unresolved evidence or reports confidence at or below 50 percent.
hypothesis: The deterministic audit will trigger both saved regressions, trigger none of the three saved improvements, emit no more than two repair queries, and make zero provider or search calls.

selection.claim_use: mechanism calibration only; forbidden as benchmark effectiveness evidence

routing_rule: Pass permits implementation of the typed single-Agent repair_search checkpoint in Pi v11. Failure requires changing or abandoning the deterministic trigger before any live provider calls.
claim_boundary: This five-case set was selected using paired outcomes. Passing it demonstrates only that the trigger matches known failure shapes; it does not estimate effectiveness.
